remarks: Welcome home to this bright, well-maintained, and move-in ready 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment with attached garage and in-unit washer/dryer offering the perfect combination of comfort and convenience. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features spacious living areas, generously sized bedrooms, and plenty of natural light throughout. Prime in-town New Canaan location close to shopping, dining, parks and Metro-North train station. Enjoy the added convenience of an attached one-car garage with additional storage space-ideal for keeping seasonal items, bikes, and outdoor gear organized. There is also a second assigned parking space in the driveway. Whether you're relaxing at home or looking for easy everyday living, this apartment has everything you need!
